notes.title: Release Notes for 26/04/2024
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 UI: Fixed an issue where the stats window would not show up when hovered over an item.
 Maps: Optimization improvements on background assets for better performance.
 Stability: Fixed an issue that caused the game to hang in some cases.

notes.title: Release Notes for 20/04/2024
notes.notes:
Changes

 Updated to be on par with the recent updates of the Early Access version.

notes.title: Release Notes for 18/04/2024
notes.notes:
Balance Changes

 Damage Reduction: All damage received from enemies has been reduced by half.
 Health Rune: Now restores health for every 5 enemies killed instead of 2.

Bug Fixes

 Rage Mode: Fixed an issue where players remained stuck in Rage Mode.
 Gamepad: Fixed a bug that interfered with performing Glory Kills using a gamepad.
 Language: Fixed texts with missing localization settings.
 Save Slots: Fixed an issue that caused save slots to display "Unknown" as the location.

notes.title: Day One Patch 16/04/2024
notes.notes:
Language
